# ⌨️ Commands

Commands are ready-made prompts you run yourself. Type the command, then what it should work on; if something it needs is missing, it asks.

| Tool | How to run |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code, GitHub Copilot | `/fix-tests tests/checkout` |
| OpenAI Codex | `$fix-tests tests/checkout` |

Commands never start on their own, so they don't compete with the skills. Many hand the work to one of the [agents](agents.md) from the same plugin. Back to the [catalog](README.md) or the [main README](../README.md).

| Command | What it does | Hands off to | Plugin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`/create-test-plan`](../src/commands/create-test-plan.md) | Explores a web app (and its API, if given), maps features to risk, and produces a prioritized test plan with web and API scenarios, saved to .qa/test-plan.md. | [`test-planner`](../src/agents/test-planner.md) | `qa-core` |
| [`/test-plan-basic`](../src/commands/test-plan-basic.md) | Produces a quick, single-pass test plan for a website from a short read-only exploration of its main flows, saved to .qa/basic-test-plan.md. |  | `qa-core` |
| [`/qa-strategy`](../src/commands/qa-strategy.md) | Builds a scenario matrix for a feature, user story, or API spec across six lenses (happy path, boundary, negative, OWASP Top 10 security, adversarial sequences, data integrity), with an OWASP coverage table and open questions. | [`qa-strategist`](../src/agents/qa-strategist.md) | `qa-core` |
| [`/review-requirements`](../src/commands/review-requirements.md) | Reviews a user story, PRD, or acceptance criteria for ambiguity, contradictions, missing states, and untestable statements, and returns clarifying questions plus rewritten, testable acceptance criteria. | [`qa-strategist`](../src/agents/qa-strategist.md) | `qa-core` |
| [`/regression-scope`](../src/commands/regression-scope.md) | Turns a diff, PR summary, changed files, or hotfix description into a prioritized regression scope (must, should, sample, defer) with a minimal confidence suite and retest guidance for testers. | [`qa-strategist`](../src/agents/qa-strategist.md) | `qa-core` |

| [`/generate-test-data`](../src/commands/generate-test-data.md) | Designs a reusable test data catalog (valid baselines, boundaries, invalid inputs, role and state combinations) from requirements, constraints, a test plan, or the codebase, for manual and automated testing. | [`test-planner`](../src/agents/test-planner.md) | `qa-core` |
